observed: 2026-10-09 in a signed-in Chrome over Browser Harness, read-only, on a Growth-plan workspace. Labels are Clay's accessible names; ids are placeholders.
notes: Every url is relative to https://app.clay.com and is pushed through Clay's own router (history.pushState + popstate), which re-renders the page without a document load. arrive is the cheap arrival check: the path prefix plus one stable element. api names the faster read when one exists. Click steps never press a control whose label matches gate_words; gate controls are listed per state and live in package.json as forbidden edges. A step marked kind menu, tab or nav opens a menu or applies a read-only filter and carries user data in its label (a column, view or sequence name), so its label skips the gate-word check; every such step was opened and closed live on 2026-10-09.

home.api: clay folders list; clay workbooks list (one call each)

tables-list.api: clay tables list; clay workbooks list

table.api: clay tables get {t}; clay tables columns; clay tables rows
table.note: Redirects to .../tables/{t}/views/{gv}; the default view id comes back in the URL.
gates: Sandbox Mode (creates a sandbox copy, observed 2026-10-09)

run-mode.note: The toolbar button reads Manual or Auto. The dialog holds the table Auto-run switch: read it, never flip it.

column-settings.api: clay tables columns {t} (saved config, prompt tokens, auto-run)

gates: every item creates a column draft; the column exists only after Save

enrichment-panel.note: Cmd+E is documented to open the same panel.

row-selected.note: Selection is local UI state; click the same checkbox again to clear it.

find-leads-menu.api: clay searches (people and companies, no chat session)
gates: Company lookalikes (each opens a new /chats/{cc} session)

blocklist.api: POST global-blocklist/add is the write; reading is this page

sequencer-events.note: Opens the workspace's sequencer events table, a normal workbook table; cache its URL after the first visit.

master-inbox.api: bin/clay-inbox (65 replies with threads in ~3 s)
master-inbox.note: No URL state for the selected sequence or thread. Opening the inbox selects a thread itself.

inbox-campaign.note: Sequences are grouped by the first three name segments; click the group, then the sequence.

inbox-thread.note: Thread rows are cursor-pointer divs in the middle column (Tailwind w-96); there is no role or test id, so this locator is the most fragile in the map.

campaign.api: clay campaigns get {cam}; clay campaigns sequence
campaign.note: This is the sequence editor. Its message bodies are editable in place; never type into them.

campaign-replies.note: Selects a thread on open, like the master inbox.

signals.api: clay signals list; clay signals get

workflow.api: clay workflows get {wf}; clay workflows runs

gates: API keys tab: anything that creates or shows a key

credits.api: bin/clay-balance or clay credits balance (one call)
